_comment: Layering rules over the dune graph. `from` and `to` are fnmatch patterns
matched against node ids of the form `<lib|exe>:<dir under src>:<name>`.
forbidden -- enforced by `make check-deps`; every rule here holds today.
pending   -- rules we want; reported by `make deps-advice`, not enforced.
Move a rule from `pending` to `forbidden` in the same PR that fixes it.

forbidden.why: Cryptographic primitives must not depend on the daemon.
Cryptographic primitives must not depend on networking.
Cryptographic primitives must not depend on the GraphQL layer.
The base types must not depend on the daemon that consumes them.
Libraries must not depend on applications.
Nothing may depend on an executable stanza.
mina-logproc is a log formatter; it must stay off the protocol stack.
The Caqti helpers must not depend on applications.

mina_caqti is a generic helper library over the Caqti bindings. Depending on the protocol stack for two variant types made every database tool carry the whole of Mina; the zkApp Set_or_keep/Or_ignore wrappers live in archive_lib instead (Zkapp_caqti).

pending.why: generate_keypair uses one symbol from cli_lib (Cli_lib.Commands.generate_keypair) and pays 176 libraries for it. Splitting the keypair commands out of cli_lib would make this a bare binary.
Same as generate_keypair: one symbol from cli_lib, 176 libraries of cost.
genesis_ledger_helper never references Cli_lib, but the edge drags the daemon CLI into the whole archive toolchain.
